content: Level Four, the ancient philosophers now called illuminationists, also hold the sensory moon cannot be split. For them light is the principle of manifestation; the moon is a metaphor for the light intermixed with bodily darkness, and its splitting is the manifestation of all the knowledge it contained potentially, universals and particulars, to the denizens of the world. Since the apex of existents is the level of the Seal, the splitting is again peculiar to the Prophet.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
